{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-tx-c","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"f54eceb545cd7ca9e59fb29a4926f05b586d8c92dbd42adbd6f47bb8d217a707","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-tx-class-c:lineage:82","source_registry_sha256":"73669019241a96617275447ad5e45b56c17a2d4bd395699448d85850cfc5bafb","source_liveness_sha256":"09f3b07a722a229b5a39dcb8c5d896c464ba2c2aace4fd45c8b20f536a767fd7"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Some Special Driving Situations","heading":"C2 — Confusables and KG hints","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Special Driving Situations

FACT_ID: sec09-R01 | anchor: A01
Use headlights from a half-hour after sunset to a half-hour before sunrise, or whenever people or vehicles cannot be seen clearly for at least one thousand feet. Use low beams within five hundred feet of an approaching vehicle or when following another vehicle within three hundred feet [A01].
Why it matters: group night-driving; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec09-F01, sec09-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: sec09-R02 | anchor: A01
Highway entries yield to flow, ride right-side speed lanes, signal left, and accelerate into merges [A01].
Why it matters: group highway-driving; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec09-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: sec09-R03 | anchor: A01
Right lanes pace slow, middle and left lanes pace fast or pass, and exits stage early with signs one thousand yards out [A01] [A02].
Why it matters: group highway-driving; difficulty low; prereq sec09-F03; confusables sec09-F04, sec09-F05 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: sec09-R04 | anchor: A02
Gaps hold two seconds dry and four seconds foul, trips break every two hours or one hundred miles, and days cap at eight hours [A02].
Why it matters: group highway-safety; difficulty medium; prereq sec09-F04; confusables sec09-F04, sec09-F06 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec09-R05 | anchor: A02
Breakdowns empty people first, then cars, then light everything, then signal distress with cloth or hood [A02].
Why it matters: group breakdowns; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec09-F07 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec09-R06 | anchor: A02
Skids steer into slides, brake failures ease parking brakes with low gears, departures slow before re-entering, and flats stop straight, all without slammed brakes [A02] [A03].
Why it matters: group emergencies; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec09-F08, sec09-F09 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec09-R07 | anchor: A03
Winter admits no safe speed and no trustworthy chains, suspects bridges and shade first, and starts and stops gently [A03].
Why it matters: group winter; difficulty medium; prereq sec09-F08; confusables sec09-F10 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: sec09-R08 | anchor: A04
Roundabouts yield to circling traffic, loop counterclockwise, exit right with signals, and never halt inside for sirens [A04].
Why it matters: group roundabouts; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec09-F11 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec09-R09 | anchor: A04
Six inches of water steals control, twelve inches floats cars, and two rushing feet carry trucks, so drowned routes turn around [A04].
Why it matters: group floods; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec09-F12 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec09-R10 | anchor: A05
Truck passes cost three to five extra seconds with headlight flashes, and returns wait for flashed clearance plus full truck fronts in mirrors [A05].
Why it matters: group trucks; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec09-F13 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec09-R11 | anchor: A05
Cars stop near two hundred forty feet while loaded rigs need four hundred plus, unseen drivers mean unseen cars, and turbulence pushes apart [A05].
Why it matters: group trucks; difficulty medium; prereq sec09-F13; confusables sec09-F14 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec09-R12 | anchor: A06
The most common car-motorcycle collision is a car turning left in front of a motorcycle at an intersection. Motorcyclists are often hidden in blind spots; check mirrors and blind spots before lane changes and at intersections, signal before changing lanes or merging, and allow a motorcycle its full lane width [A06].
Why it matters: group motorcycles; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec09-F16, sec09-F17 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec09-R13 | anchor: A08
Bikes trail four to six seconds back, rails demand never-on-tracks discipline, and cycles claim full lanes against hooks and pullouts [A08] [A07].
Why it matters: group bikes-rail; difficulty high; prereq sec09-F16; confusables sec09-F18, sec09-F19 [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec09-R14 | anchor: A08
Half-second delays double crashes, and texting bans all reading, writing, and sending outside law and emergency calls [A08].
Why it matters: group distraction; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec09-F20, sec09-F21 [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0060]
